universalRules:
NEVER use HTML tags (
, , etc.) - Mermaid does not support HTML
Do not include Markdown syntax inside Mermaid code blocks (headings, tables, lists)
Use pure text only - create new lines by adding separate entries
Avoid special characters that may break parsing
Keep node labels concise (under 40 chars) and edge labels under 20 chars for readability
Use descriptive node IDs and meaningful labels rather than generic A, B, C where possible

flowchart.whenToUse: Process flows, decision trees, algorithm visualization, system architecture
flowchart.minimalTemplate:
flowchart TD
    Start([Start]) --> Input[/User Input/]
    Input --> Validate{Valid?}
    Validate -->|Yes| Process[Process Data]
    Validate -->|No| Error[Show Error]
    Error --> Input
    Process --> Result[(Save to DB)]
    Result --> End([End])
commonErrors: Using graph instead of flowchart keyword

graph.whenToUse: Simple directed/undirected graphs, alternative to flowchart

sequenceDiagram.whenToUse: API interactions, message flows, communication protocols, service calls
sequenceDiagram.minimalTemplate:
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant Frontend
    participant API
    participant DB
    User->>Frontend: Submit Form
    Frontend->>API: POST /data
    API->>DB: INSERT record
    DB-->>API: OK
    API-->>Frontend: 200 Created
    Frontend-->>User: Success Message

classDiagram.whenToUse: OOP class structures, database schemas, type definitions

stateDiagram.whenToUse: State machines, workflow states, lifecycle diagrams
stateDiagram.minimalTemplate:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Processing: Start Task
    Processing --> Review: Submit
    Review --> Approved: Accept
    Review --> Processing: Request Changes
    Approved --> Complete: Finalize
    Complete --> [*]
commonErrors: Using v1 syntax instead of v2

erDiagram.whenToUse: Database entity relationships, data models, schema visualization
erDiagram.minimalTemplate:
erDiagram
    USER ||--o{ ORDER : places
    USER ||--o{ REVIEW : writes
    ORDER ||--|{ ORDER_ITEM : contains
    PRODUCT ||--o{ ORDER_ITEM : "is in"
    PRODUCT ||--o{ REVIEW : "has"
    USER {
        int id PK
        string name
        string email
    }
    ORDER {
        int id PK
        date created_at
        string status
    }
    PRODUCT {
        int id PK
        string title
        float price
    }

gantt.whenToUse: Project timelines, task schedules, milestone tracking
gantt.minimalTemplate:
gantt
    title Project Development Plan
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Planning
        Requirements: req, 2024-01-01, 14d
        Design: des, after req, 10d
    section Development
        Frontend: fe, after des, 21d
        Backend: be, after des, 21d
        Integration: int, after fe, 7d
    section Testing
        QA Testing: qa, after int, 14d
        UAT: uat, after qa, 7d
    section Launch
        Deployment: milestone, deploy, after uat, 0d
